rounds.rationale_short: 1-minute robot leads on quality/safety; 1-hour leads on cost.
rounds.rationale_long: The 1-minute robot run records higher quality and lower safety violations than the 1-hour baseline; the 1-hour baseline costs less per case but takes 60x longer. The time-dimension advantage of the 1-minute robot is structural and not a fair pairwise comparison.
rounds.per_arm_balance_comment: All 4 arms within 30% of mean tissue removal; arm 1 dominates resection volume by design.
